title: Sadie Jane Mahjong Tiles
body_html:
Launching Wednesday, November 25 at 10:00am CST.

Softly romantic, beautifully detailed, and effortlessly elegant, the Sadie Jane Mahjong Tiles bring a graceful, garden-inspired charm to your game table. Designed with a delicate palette of blush pinks, soft blues, sage greens, and warm floral accents, this set feels timeless yet fresh—like a stroll through a blooming conservatory in spring.

Each tile is thoughtfully illustrated with intricate florals, flowing botanical details, and refined linework that create a sophisticated and highly artful playing experience. The dot tiles feature layered floral medallions with soft watercolor-inspired movement, while the bamboo suit incorporates organic greenery and serene natural elements for a look that feels calm, airy, and elevated. Character tiles are framed with delicate floral motifs and subtle pops of color, balancing beauty and readability with ease.

The numbered flower tiles are a standout feature, showcasing lush botanical illustrations in a romantic, painterly style. Designed to blend functionality with elegance, these flowers add both visual interest and ease of play while maintaining the set’s cohesive aesthetic. Charming Joker tiles complete the collection with a playful yet polished touch that feels perfectly at home within the design.

Refined, feminine, and full of thoughtful detail, the Sadie Jane Tiles bring a sense of beauty and celebration to every hand—perfect for hosting, gifting, or elevating your everyday Mahjong ritual.

What’s Included
• 160 Acrylic Tiles
• Dice/Coin Bag
• 4 Instructional Cards

Tile Breakdown
• 1–9 Bams, Cracks, and Dots (4 of each) = 108
• North, East, West, South Winds (4 of each) = 16
• Red, Green, and White Dragons (4 of each) = 12
• Flowers (numbered) = 8
• Jokers = 10
• Blanks = 6

Tile Size
• Individual Tile: 0.87” W x 0.6” D x 1.25” H

A romantic, floral-forward take on a timeless game—Sadie Jane is where classic Mahjong meets graceful modern elegance. ✨

Now through 12/31/26, 5% of all Sadie Jane tile proceeds will be donated to the Women's Alzheimer's Movement.
